name: New line - iPhone 17 Pro Max $14.99 no trade-in - Extra 2.0
description: Offers checked on att.com/buy/phones and att.com/bundles/internet-wireless on 2026-11-25. Customer voice: fast, upbeat young professional.
scripted_messages: Hey! Adding a new line for a work phone, and I want the iPhone 17 Pro Max which your site shows at $14.99 a month with a new line and no trade-in. Which plan would you suggest between Extra 2.0 and Premium 2.0 for heavy streaming, and what would the total monthly be on each?
Nice. Is that $14.99 including the extra $5.56 credit you guys mention?
And does that credit stay the same all 36 months?
One more, what would the first bill be with the activation fee and taxes?
Okay, that's a bit more than I figured for month one, but you explained it all really well and I appreciate how friendly you were.
That's it for me. Have a great one, bye!
_expected_agent_flow: before message 1: agent: greeting, asks for first and last name
before message 2: agent: welcomes the customer, asks how they can help
before message 3: agent: 'please give me a moment' while checking
before message 4: agent: gives the answer/quote
before message 5: agent: answers the previous question
before message 6: agent: answers the follow-up (a bill question usually gets 'please allow me a moment to calculate')
before message 7: agent: waiting message while calculating the bill
before message 8: agent: gives the detail / the calculated bill
before message 9: agent: 'Is there anything else I can help you with today?'
